title: oncidium gloriosum var. flaviflorum
intro: Oncidium gloriosum var. flaviflorum, commonly known as the yellow-flowered Oncidium, is a species of orchid that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties, which may aid in the treatment of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents present in Oncidium gloriosum var. flaviflorum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of this plant may also include its potential to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and provide antioxidant protection against oxidative stress.
